step1_analysis.description: A current-mirror based auto-biased amplifier designed to overcome large Vth and mobility variations in organic transistors. It provides a stable, linear inverting response by balancing pull-up and pull-down currents through replica biasing, ensuring the output DC operating point tracks the input.

paper_reference.title: Insole Pedometer with Piezoelectric Energy Harvester and 2V Organic Digital and Analog Circuits

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the amplifier at typical bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total = I_d1 + I_d4. At Vin=0.9V, Vov_p = 0.48V. I_d4 = 0.5 * 50u * 10 * 0.48^2 = 57uA. Total current = 114uA. Power = 1.8V * 114uA = 205uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using Sky130 mobility and Vth for the given W/L=10.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = -sqrt(mu_p / mu_n) = -sqrt(50/270) = -0.43 V/V. In dB: 20*log10(0.43) = -7.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The replica bias forces Vout to track Vn0, making the gain dependent only on the mobility ratio when W/L are equal.

sky130_expected.calculation: Solve Vtrip = Vthn + sqrt(mu_p/mu_n)*(VDD - Vtrip - |Vthp|). Vtrip = 0.42 + 0.43*(1.8 - Vtrip - 0.42) -> Vtrip = 0.7V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the intersection of the input and output voltages on the DC transfer curve.

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard nominal VDD for Sky130 1.8V devices.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, transfer curve trip point, AC gain, and transient response of the variation-tolerant amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Variation-Tolerant Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 OUT IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT N0 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 10 0 0)

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(OUT)

  * 2. DC Sweep for Transfer Curve and Trip Point
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  let vdiff = v(OUT) - v(IN)
  meas dc trip_point when vdiff=0
  meas dc dc_gain_v deriv v(OUT) at=0.9

  * 3. AC Analysis for Gain
  ac dec 10 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
  meas ac low_freq_gain_db find gain_db at=10

  * 4. Transient Analysis
  tran 1m 0.5
  meas tran vout_max max v(OUT)
  meas tran vout_min min v(OUT)
  meas tran vout_pk2pk param='vout_max - vout_min'
  
  quit
.endc
.end
